description: Retrieval-quality golden set (course milestone M8). Each suite is a small corpus of existing test cases; each query is how a user or a failing run would describe one of them, deliberately reworded (synonyms, different phrasing) so lexical overlap alone is not enough. 'relevant' lists the corpus ids a correct retriever should rank first.

corpus.title: Login with valid credentials succeeds
corpus.description: Enter a correct username and password and submit; the dashboard loads.

corpus.title: Login with wrong password shows an error
corpus.description: A valid username with an incorrect password displays an invalid-credentials message.

corpus.title: Account locks after five failed attempts
corpus.description: Five consecutive bad passwords lock the account for 15 minutes.

corpus.title: Password reset email is sent

corpus.title: Expired reset link is rejected
corpus.description: Opening a reset link after 24 hours shows an expiry error.

corpus.title: Session expires after inactivity
